request.prompt: The empty abandoned theater stage, a single old follow-spotlight suddenly switches on by itself, a hard white circle of light on the empty dusty boards, the torn red curtain behind, darkness everywhere else. Cinematic film still from a 1990s Chinese arthouse mystery film, shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, anamorphic lens, muted desaturated teal and amber palette, deep shadows, halation around lights, fine film grain, hyper-realistic, dreamlike, wide 2.39:1 framing with all important content in the central horizontal band.
